notes: Only assigned replication fields examined. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders. Supplied canonical source is a manual partial transcription of p. 19, Table S1 of the Camerer et al. Science supplement; no PDF was supplied. No acquisition performed. Printed r retained despite requested metric Mean difference. No effect conversion. Replication p and r come from the same named table row. N is author-provided Replication N*, explicitly a study participant count, not proven critical-model analytic N; no sums or df-based derivation. Replicated Yes/No is the authors’ explicit categorical verdict, mapped to successful/failed.
